text:
marta: Hey team — kicking off a joint SI + marketplace observability demo with SignalSphere (SI). Scope: OTLP-compatible collector for private deployments, Datadog dashboard templates for cloud listing, and an air-gapped installer runbook. Who can own the technical runbook?

devon: I can take the runbook. Plan: produce a minimal OTLP collector config, a Datadog dashboard JSON, and a Terraform quickstart for marketplace tile. Will need sample traces and a short trace/span naming convention doc.

ashok: For air-gapped environments we should avoid remote exporters. Suggest collector -> file exporter + guidance to push via scp or partner-managed transfer. Minimal collector snippet I recommend:```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  file:
    path: /tmp/otel-bundle.json
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [file]
```
This keeps the example reproducible without internet.

sylvia: Legal/partner ops asks about announcement timing and embargo. Proposed target: 2025-03-10 for joint demo blog + marketplace tile. Need SignalSphere NDA amendment + marketplace listing approval by 2025-02-21.

marta: Also need GPU partner (NVIDIA SI lead) to approve the dashboard pull-through for perf traces — spans that show batch sizes / kv-cache hits. @partner-bot can you attach the checklist for vendor approvals?

partner-bot: Checklist update: marketplace draft uploaded (PR #412), security review queued, vendor approval pending (NVIDIA contact assigned). Next step: runbook doc assigned to devon. ETA for security review: ~3 business days.

devon: Dev notes: dashboard templates will include 3 widgets: 99th-pct latency by model, token throughput per instance, and KV cache hit ratio. I'll add a sample span naming pattern: `inference.request -> model.forward -> runtime.kv_hit` so SI can map spans easily.

ashok: One more on telemetry volume — recommend default trace sampling at 10% for demo workloads and keep logs full for any error-level events. We'll include a short snippet to toggle sampling in the collector config.

mktg-ops: From marketing: we need one hero metric and a one-slide benchmarking graphic comparing latency and cost with/without Redwood batching. Eng: can someone produce a 2-min benchmark run to capture 99th-pct baseline and optimized?

sylvia: Also flagging partner co-marketing assets required: joint logo lockup, approved boilerplate, and one customer quote or lab benchmark. Legal will circulate the boilerplate by EOD.

marta: Target internal review by Friday (3 days). Can we schedule a 30-min sync with SignalSphere and NVIDIA SI for next Wed at 10am PT? If that works I'll send invites. :calendar: 

devon: Works for me. I'll start the repo scaffold under `partners/signal-sphere/obs-demo` and post initial PR with collector + dashboard samples.

ashok: I'll add the airgap runbook section and an ops checklist for transfers.

marta: Awesome — thanks. If anyone hits blockers ping me or @sylvia.
